about: House rule STORY_INTRO_OUTRO: every video, in both sizes, opens with an animated branded intro made for its own story, carries a designed audio treatment, and closes on an animated outro card made for that piece. Read by .agents/skills/produce-video, which stops before the final render while status is not "approved". Nothing here is designed yet: the designs go to Krish first (krish-design), and only his words approve one.

said.words: when the videos come back bear in mind that I want a proper animated branded intro to this specific story visually, the audio treatment, and then a proper animated outro card. Across all formats, and this should be part of the system moving forward.

required.story_intro: a proper animated, branded intro made for this specific story, in the 16:9 long cut and the 9:16 short cut
required.audio_treatment: the audio treatment that goes with it, across the intro, the voice and the outro
required.outro_card: a proper animated outro card made for this piece, in the 16:9 long cut and the 9:16 short cut

until_approved: story intro and outro not designed yet
